info.title: Personas
info.description: Personas builds an evidence-grounded reviewer persona of a specific engineer from their history (PRs, review comments, commits, code, docs) and reviews pull requests the way that person would. Ships the embedding model baked in, so installed personas work with zero downloads. Run with `dnx Personas review --persona <name> --diff <path>`.

options.name: --data
options.description: Data directory. Defaults to $PERSONAS_HOME, else ~/.personas

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file path, reserved for upcoming workflows

options.name: --query
options.description: Search query text

options.name: --persona
options.description: Persona name (installed) or path to a .persona bundle. Repeat to run a merged team/domain review

options.name: --provider
options.description: Review provider. Currently supports azure-devops

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository name/id for provider-backed review

options.name: --ado-pr
options.description: Azure DevOps pull request id for provider-backed review

options.name: --gh-pr
options.description: GitHub pull request number for provider-backed review

options.name: --diff
options.description: Diff file path for review. Can be repeated

options.name: --focus
options.description: Per-review override of review.focus: auto | single | per-file

options.name: --context
options.description: Supporting non-diff file for review. Can be repeated

options.name: --out
options.description: Output bundle path for export. Defaults to ./<persona-id>.persona

options.name: --full
options.description: Export the full tier (default): pack + historical index/store for precedent retrieval

options.name: --pack
options.description: Export the pack-only tier: the distilled brain (rubric/memories/tone), no historical index

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet feed (v3 index URL or local folder) for install-by-package-id and the push hint from pack

options.name: --package-id
options.description: NuGet package id produced by `pack`

options.name: --as
options.description: Export/pack under a privacy alias: re-keys the bundle and scrubs the engineer's real id/name/email from the metadata (drops identity-map.json). Pack requires a single --persona.

options.name: --eval-file
options.description: Evaluation fixture JSON path

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of search results. Defaults to 40

options.name: --persist-run-artifacts
options.description: Persist context-pack, agent-input, agent-output, and verified-output JSON for ask/review/eval

options.name: --run-artifacts-dir
options.description: Directory for persisted run artifacts. Enables persistence. Defaults to <data>/runs

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite generated files where supported (build, install)
--code-changes-only Re-ingest only Azure DevOps PR iteration changes; skips
PRs/comments/commits/work-items/documents/GitHub/local-git

options.name: --repo-wide
options.description:
Ingest every Azure DevOps PR in the repository (no identity filter)
into the scoped persona's store. Default is per-persona: each
configured persona is ingested into its OWN isolated store
(personas/<id>/) from only the PRs it authored or reviewed. Use
--persona to ingest a single persona.

options.name: --candidate
options.description: Full provider-qualified identity id (e.g. azure-devops:user@example.com)

options.name: --reason
options.description: Optional human reason recorded with identity approve/reject

options.name: --diagnose-cases
options.description: Number of historical PR cases to classify in eval-diagnose. Defaults to 25

options.name: --max-replay-pull-requests
options.description: Cap for historical PR replay in eval. Defaults to 25

options.name: --judge
options.description:
In eval historical replay, run a neutral LLM judge over each generated
finding to report JudgedPrecision (finding validity independent of
whether the historical reviewer commented on it)

options.name: --apply
options.description:
In calibrate, write the suggested review.minConfidence into persona.yaml
(default is a dry-run that only reports the suggestion)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help
Current implementation:
init                Creates the local data directory layout and sample persona.yaml
version             Prints CLI version metadata
status              Prints local data directory status as JSON
validate            Validates persona.yaml and reports JSON errors/warnings
ado-validate        Probes configured Azure DevOps repositories and PR endpoints with configured auth
ingest              Ingests configured document/transcript, Azure DevOps, and local Git sources into raw and normalized stores. Each persona is ingested into its own isolated per-persona store (override with --repo-wide).
index               Creates per-persona evidence chunks and a local SQLite FTS5 index
search              Searches indexed evidence chunks with SQLite FTS5/BM25
build               Builds persona-pack.json files from indexed evidence. Incremental: a persona whose evidence, definition, and build config are unchanged is reused (status "up_to_date"); pass --force to recompute.
refresh             One-shot incremental ingest -> index -> build for a persona (or all). Unchanged personas are reused (cachedPersonas); --force rebuilds. Reports per-stage counts in one JSON.
ask                 Answers a question using persona pack and retrieved evidence
review              Produces JSON review findings for a diff file or Azure DevOps PR. --persona accepts an installed name or a .persona bundle path.
eval                Runs fixture checks, or historical PR replay when --eval-file is omitted
eval-diagnose       Classifies hidden historical comments by retrieval failure (corpus-miss/top-k-miss/scope-miss/reachable)
calibrate           Replays historical reviews to suggest a review.minConfidence; with --apply writes it into the global review block of persona.yaml
export              Packs a built persona into a portable .persona bundle. Full tier by default (pack + historical index/store); --pack ships the distilled brain only. Bundles embed review-comment-derived content; share within your team.
pack                Packages one or more personas into a NuGet package (one or more personas per .nupkg) for `dotnet nuget push`.
pack-diff           Compares two persona packs (names, persona-pack.json/dirs, or .persona bundles) and emits a rubric/memory/matcher/tone/metadata changelog
install             Installs .persona bundles (paths) or persona NuGet packages (--source <feed>) into <data>/personas/. Personas then run by name with no persona.yaml.
list                Lists installed/built personas in the data directory
uninstall           Removes an installed persona directory from the data directory
mcp                 Starts the Personas MCP server over stdio so VS Code Copilot agent mode and the GitHub Copilot CLI can use installed personas (tools: review_pull_request, team_review, ask_persona, search_persona_evidence, list_personas, get_persona_profile). Configure with command "personas", args ["mcp"].
identity            list/approve/reject manual overrides for unresolved persona identity candidates
feedback            Records reviewer feedback on a matcher spec (--spec) or an LLM finding category (--category); repeatedly dismissed specs/categories are suppressed in later reviews

status              Prints local data directory status as JSON
validate            Validates persona.yaml and reports JSON errors/warnings
ado-validate        Probes configured Azure DevOps repositories and PR endpoints with configured auth
ingest              Ingests configured document/transcript, Azure DevOps, and local Git sources into raw and normalized stores. Each persona is ingested into its own isolated per-persona store (override with --repo-wide).
index               Creates per-persona evidence chunks and a local SQLite FTS5 index
search              Searches indexed evidence chunks with SQLite FTS5/BM25
build               Builds persona-pack.json files from indexed evidence. Incremental: a persona whose evidence, definition, and build config are unchanged is reused (status "up_to_date"); pass --force to recompute.
refresh             One-shot incremental ingest -> index -> build for a persona (or all). Unchanged personas are reused (cachedPersonas); --force rebuilds. Reports per-stage counts in one JSON.
ask                 Answers a question using persona pack and retrieved evidence
review              Produces JSON review findings for a diff file or Azure DevOps PR. --persona accepts an installed name or a .persona bundle path.
eval                Runs fixture checks, or historical PR replay when --eval-file is omitted
eval-diagnose       Classifies hidden historical comments by retrieval failure (corpus-miss/top-k-miss/scope-miss/reachable)
calibrate           Replays historical reviews to suggest a review.minConfidence; with --apply writes it into the global review block of persona.yaml
export              Packs a built persona into a portable .persona bundle. Full tier by default (pack + historical index/store); --pack ships the distilled brain only. Bundles embed review-comment-derived content; share within your team.
pack                Packages one or more personas into a NuGet package (one or more personas per .nupkg) for `dotnet nuget push`.
pack-diff           Compares two persona packs (names, persona-pack.json/dirs, or .persona bundles) and emits a rubric/memory/matcher/tone/metadata changelog
install             Installs .persona bundles (paths) or persona NuGet packages (--source <feed>) into <data>/personas/. Personas then run by name with no persona.yaml.
list                Lists installed/built personas in the data directory
uninstall           Removes an installed persona directory from the data directory
mcp                 Starts the Personas MCP server over stdio so VS Code Copilot agent mode and the GitHub Copilot CLI can use installed personas (tools: review_pull_request, team_review, ask_persona, search_persona_evidence, list_personas, get_persona_profile). Configure with command "personas", args ["mcp"].
identity            list/approve/reject manual overrides for unresolved persona identity candidates
feedback            Records reviewer feedback on a matcher spec (--spec) or an LLM finding category (--category); repeatedly dismissed specs/categories are suppressed in later reviews

options.name: --data
options.description: Data directory. Defaults to $PERSONAS_HOME, else ~/.personas

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file path, reserved for upcoming workflows

options.name: --query
options.description: Search query text

options.name: --persona
options.description: Persona name (installed) or path to a .persona bundle. Repeat to run a merged team/domain review

options.name: --provider
options.description: Review provider. Currently supports azure-devops

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository name/id for provider-backed review

options.name: --ado-pr
options.description: Azure DevOps pull request id for provider-backed review

options.name: --gh-pr
options.description: GitHub pull request number for provider-backed review

options.name: --diff
options.description: Diff file path for review. Can be repeated

options.name: --focus
options.description: Per-review override of review.focus: auto | single | per-file

options.name: --context
options.description: Supporting non-diff file for review. Can be repeated

options.name: --out
options.description: Output bundle path for export. Defaults to ./<persona-id>.persona

options.name: --full
options.description: Export the full tier (default): pack + historical index/store for precedent retrieval

options.name: --pack
options.description: Export the pack-only tier: the distilled brain (rubric/memories/tone), no historical index

options.name: --source
options.description: NuGet feed (v3 index URL or local folder) for install-by-package-id and the push hint from pack

options.name: --package-id
options.description: NuGet package id produced by `pack`

options.name: --as
options.description: Export/pack under a privacy alias: re-keys the bundle and scrubs the engineer's real id/name/email from the metadata (drops identity-map.json). Pack requires a single --persona.

options.name: --eval-file
options.description: Evaluation fixture JSON path

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of search results. Defaults to 40

options.name: --persist-run-artifacts
options.description: Persist context-pack, agent-input, agent-output, and verified-output JSON for ask/review/eval

options.name: --run-artifacts-dir
options.description: Directory for persisted run artifacts. Enables persistence. Defaults to <data>/runs

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite generated files where supported (build, install)
--code-changes-only Re-ingest only Azure DevOps PR iteration changes; skips
PRs/comments/commits/work-items/documents/GitHub/local-git

options.name: --repo-wide
options.description:
Ingest every Azure DevOps PR in the repository (no identity filter)
into the scoped persona's store. Default is per-persona: each
configured persona is ingested into its OWN isolated store
(personas/<id>/) from only the PRs it authored or reviewed. Use
--persona to ingest a single persona.

options.name: --candidate
options.description: Full provider-qualified identity id (e.g. azure-devops:user@example.com)

options.name: --reason
options.description: Optional human reason recorded with identity approve/reject

options.name: --diagnose-cases
options.description: Number of historical PR cases to classify in eval-diagnose. Defaults to 25

options.name: --max-replay-pull-requests
options.description: Cap for historical PR replay in eval. Defaults to 25

options.name: --judge
options.description:
In eval historical replay, run a neutral LLM judge over each generated
finding to report JudgedPrecision (finding validity independent of
whether the historical reviewer commented on it)

options.name: --apply
options.description:
In calibrate, write the suggested review.minConfidence into persona.yaml
(default is a dry-run that only reports the suggestion)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help
